quarterly_data.quarter: Merck KGaA press release: EMD Electronics Opens New R&D Facility in Wisconsin to (10-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: EMD Electronics, Merck KGaA's North America electronics business, opened a new 38,000-square-foot research and development facility at its Sheboygan Falls, Wisconsin site, with eight purpose-built laboratories and dedicated synthesis, scale-up and technology transfer capabilities for advanced materials for next-generation semiconductor manufacturing, meant to shorten the path from materials discovery to customer qualification. The facility is part of a $200 million multi-year investment in EMD Electronics' U.S. semiconductor capabilities across three states, which also includes a further expansion in Sheboygan Falls to be completed in 2027 and recent project completions in Carlsbad, California and Catoosa, Oklahoma; that investment is part of the company's $1 billion 5-year U.S. investment program announced in 2021. Bing Han, Head of Thin Films: integrated workflow solutions are playing a defining role 'particularly as AI drives increasing complexity and performance requirements'.
quarterly_data.figure: 38,000-square-foot R&D facility; part of a $200 million multi-year U.S. investment (further Sheboygan Falls expansion to be completed in 2027); $1 billion 5-year U.S. investment program
